jobs.description:
Digital Health Innovation (DHI) is hiring a remote Onboarding Specialist to guide organizations in the set up and adoption of their software platforms. The work involves owning the adoption process: understanding the customer’s use-case, preparing the platform for their contract, and the facilitation of training, onboarding, and support activities.

* **Position Title:** Onboarding Specialist
* **Status:** Independent contractor, long-term
* **Location:** Remote (home-based), United States
* **Hours:** Somewhat flexible. Monday through Friday (about 20-25 hours per week)
* **Compensation:** Based on experience, paid every two weeks. Long term contractors earn time off with pay.

**About Us:** Digital Health Innovation (DHI) and Behavioral Health Innovation (BHI) together form a boutique healthcare software company based in the Charlotte, North Carolina area, building secure, cloud-based platforms that help universities, K-12 school districts, and behavioral health organizations support the people they serve. Founded on more than 30 years of behavioral health and technology leadership, we combine rigorous security and software standards with the responsiveness and personal attention of a dedicated focused team.

**Key Responsibilities**

* The goal is to set up, guide and support customers in the use of the software, leaving customers happy, confident and self-sufficient. Responsibilities include:
* Lead onboarding for each new university customer from contract signature to go-live: kickoff call, timeline, checklist, and go-live confirmation.
* Configure the platform to each customer's preferences (user roles, settings, forms, and workflows) and record every choice made.
* Coordinate with customer staff and campus IT contacts on approvals, access, and security or privacy questions and other needs.
* Train customer staff live and with clear written guides so they can run the system and train their own colleagues.
* Anticipate and prevent problems: identify blockers such as approvals, term start dates, and access early, and raise them before they delay go-live.
* Create, document, and maintain onboarding workflows, checklists, and templates where none exist. Follow them consistently and improve them after each customer.
* Keep accurate records of each customer's status, decisions, and open items.
* Escalate product issues and feature requests to the development team with clear, reproducible details.
* Serve as a liaison between customer and DHI-BHI staff and support the customer as needed.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications Required**

* 3 to 5 years in a similar implementation, onboarding, or customer-facing role, owning processes end-to-end.
* Tech-savvy: learns web-based software quickly, is comfortable configuring settings, and can troubleshoot basic problems.
* Detail-oriented, organized, and reliable at follow-through.
* Self-leadership. Takes initiative in the work without needing prompting, post training.
* A record of creating workflows, checklists, or documentation where none existed, following and improving them.
* Excellent spoken and written English, with the ability to explain technical steps to non-technical staff.
* Sound judgment and composure with busy or frustrated staff, and a serious approach to commitments.
* Own computer with adequate performance, and stable internet suitable for video conferencing.
* Availability to work in the timeframe required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with higher education, healthcare, or behavioral health technology.
* Prior software implementation, onboarding, or customer training experience.

**Holidays**

* **Major Holidays Off:** New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.
* **Flexible Holiday Schedule:** Observed holidays may be shifted to other days by agreement, with at least 7 days' advance notice.

**Engagement Terms**

This is a home-based, long-term independent contractor position.

* **Work Environment:** You provide your own computer and stable internet suitable for daily video conferencing.
* **Time and Payment:** Hours are tracked with time-tracking software, and that record is the basis for payment. Payment is made every two weeks by electronic payment.

By combining intelligent automation, AI, and seamless integrations with the tools finance teams already know and trust, we empower organizations to make faster, smarter decisions with confidence. With approximately 350 employees worldwide, we're building the next generation of finance technology - where innovation, collaboration, and customer success go hand in hand.

If you're looking for a fantastic opportunity to join a growing startup in a role with massive impact, we would love to meet you!

This position is 100% remote-based anywhere in the United States. No sponsorship or relocation assistance is available.

**What You'll Do**

The Customer Success Team Lead (Implementation) plays a critical role in ensuring the successful implementation of the Datarails platform for the Datarails customers. The Team Lead will manage a team of Implementation CSMs and various Datarails resources to deliver high-quality implementation that meets and exceeds customer expectations. The Team Lead will oversee the entire implementation process, from initial planning to final deployment, ensuring projects are completed on time, within sales-scoped hours.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Team Leadership and Development
* + Manage and lead a team of implementation CSMs. You'll be responsible for hiring, training, and coaching your team to take their success to new heights.
  + Ongoing mentorship and weekly 1:1s leading conversations around each individual's growth and career path. Conduct regular performance reviews and provide constructive feedback.
  + Foster a collaborative and high-performance team environment; Team should be comfortable reaching out to other team members to discuss best practices, implementation approaches and build overall team camaraderie. The Team Lead should be spearheading this effort through ongoing coaching and encouraging open dialogue and collaboration.

* + Oversee multiple implementation projects simultaneously, guiding and being the technical focal point for implementation.
  + Oversee the team project plans for the implementation, timelines, and scoped hours.
  + Review and approve the conclusion of the implementation (handoff to live) process to ensure implementations meet customer expectations.
  + Identify and escalate project risks and issues to the CS leadership and to other teams when needed (Sales, Product, RnD).

  + Conduct a status meeting with customers and provide detailed project updates. And check the implementation progress and feedback.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration and Process Improvement:

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  
  
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  
  
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

#### **The Role**

Global Seller Onboarding Specialistsmanage the final stages of the sales funnel, working with US merchants to drive the deal through to activation and accelerate the onboarding process. Global Seller Onboarding Specialists use deep product and industry knowledge to project-manage the onboarding stage of the sales process. They'll be responsible for and guiding sellers through the discovery and onboarding journey and ensuring that sellers are optimally scoped, educated, set up and trained to leverage the potential of Square's platform. They are additionally instrumental in ensuring the documentation and tracking of feature requests to inform future product roadmaps. This is a customer-facing role that involves a combination of remote and onsite merchant interactions.

A successful Implementation Specialists will: (1) provide an incredible onboarding experience for Sellers, (2) accelerate the sales cycle by specialising onboarding and training, (3) develop new efficiencies to shorten the onboarding sales stage, and (4) support Square's international expansion efforts.

#### **You Will**

* Drive world-class onboarding and implementation experiences for Square's sellers, ensuring accountability to go-live timelines and accelerating deal velocity wherever possible.
* Cultivate strong cross-functional relationships with Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product to align on the seller journey, remove barriers, and deliver faster outcomes.
* Anticipate and resolve obstacles by managing stakeholder communications and developing scalable strategies that drive consistent success.  
  Master Square's platform, products, integrations, and ecosystem, staying ahead of new features and releases to serve as a trusted subject-matter expert.
* Lead high-impact, multi-merchant projects with competing priorities, ensuring effective resource allocation and timely delivery.
* Create and maintain engaging training materials for both internal teams and external partners.
* Execute accurate data entry and migration tasks for select sellers as part of the onboarding process

**Your typical day will include:**

* Remote merchant work: virtual consultation calls and training, advising on hardware/software/operations, staff training, menu building, and hardware installation.
* Occasional onsite merchant work, including training and hardware install.
* Data Entry: configure customer account, optimise menu setup, and other data entry tasks involved in getting a merchant onboard.

#### **You Have**

* BA/BS degree, preferably
* 4-5+ years of experience in a customer facing role, preferably in software implementation, support, sales/account management or customer success.
* An infectiously positive attitude, as well as a desire to perform at a high level on a continuous basis, and uplift the team around you.
* Bias for action; performance driven with the confidence to operate independently.
* Ability to thrive within ambiguity and operate independently.
* Ability to drive and manage multiple cross-functional initiatives simultaneously; strong time management, and excellent written & verbal communication skills.
* Proven track record of success in delivering multiple complex projects in the technology industry while partnering with external and internal clients to attain deliverables.
* An ability to learn quickly as new products and organisational changes are released.
* Previous Project Management experience is expected.
* Experience in the POS, Payments or Tech industries is a plus.
* Experience in hardware installation and network configuration is a plus.
* Must be located in PST/MST time zone.
* Must be bilingual in English and Spanish.

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About UKON**

UKON exists to help every business survive a cyberattack.  
Formerly known as FifthWall Solutions, we have grown from our foundation as a specialized cyber insurance wholesaler into a full-service cyber revenue partner for independent insurance agencies and managed service providers. We give our partners the technology, processes, carrier access, and expertise they need to deliver sophisticated cyber capabilities without the cost and complexity of building an internal cyber department.  
Today, our team works inside our partners’ books of business to identify uninsured companies, understand their risk, secure the right coverage, and help get more businesses protected. With access to more than 50 carriers and differentiated coverage options, including custom endorsements for emerging risks such as agentic AI, we help businesses understand what they are buying and how their coverage will respond when they need it most.  
We are building the AI-native operating system that will make this work scalable. Our platform brings together fragmented agency data, cybersecurity context, carrier appetite, quoting, communications, and workflows to shorten the distance between an uninsured business and a protected one.  
For us, AI-native does not mean adding a chatbot to an existing product. It means embedding intelligence throughout the platform so the system can understand the context of a user’s work, recommend the right next action, and help complete that action within the workflow. Because we operate in insurance, we care as much about accuracy, reliability, auditability, data privacy, and user control as we do about model capability.  
Our mission is ambitious but simple: close the estimated $10 trillion cyber protection gap and ensure every business can survive a cyberattack.

**The Role**

You will be UKON's first Implementation Specialist, reporting to our executive team and working closely with our product, sales, and Cyber Practice Leaders (CPLs), teams. This is a greenfield role. You are being hired to build it.

UKON partners with independent insurance agencies and managed service providers to deliver an outsourced cyber practice. Signing a partnership is only the beginning. Implementation turns a signed agreement into an active, growing agency relationship: getting the agency onboarded, trained, connected to their CPL, and producing. Today that process runs on effort and goodwill. Your job is to turn it into a repeatable system.

You will design the agency onboarding standard, the handoff from sales to CPLs, the training standards, and the implementation playbook, and then run them. You will decide what good looks like, measure it, and keep improving it. This starts as an individual contributor role, with the opportunity to own and grow the implementation function as UKON scales.

Experience implementing technology and managing projects matters more to us than experience in insurance. If you’ve helped customers get up and running on a SaaS or technology product, kept projects on track, and built or improved the process along the way, we want to talk to you.

**What You'll Do**

* Build UKON's agency onboarding standard from the ground up, from signed agreement to active, producing partner.
* Design and run the handoff process between sales and Cyber Practice Leaders so nothing is lost between signature and launch.
* Create training standards and materials that get agencies and their producers confident and active quickly.
* Write and maintain the implementation playbook, including operating procedures, checklists, timelines, and escalation paths.
* Own the implementation pipeline for new agency partners and keep every account moving forward.
* Define implementation metrics, track progress, and report on what is working and what is not.
* Identify where agencies stall after signing and fix the root cause, whether it sits in process, product, or people.
* Partner with sales, CPLs, marketing, and product to feed agency feedback back into how we sell, support, and build.
* Use project management and AI tools to run implementation efficiently and at scale.

**What You Bring**

* At least 5 years of onboarding, implementation, or customer success experience with SaaS or technology products.
* A track record of building operating procedures and processes from scratch, not just following existing ones.
* Project management experience, including running multiple concurrent implementations with tools like Asana, Monday, ClickUp, or similar.
* Exceptional attention to detail and a process-driven, high-ownership approach to your work.
* The relational skill to work across sales, CPLs, and agency partners and earn their trust.
* Comfort coordinating and directing the work of others, even without formal authority.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn messy processes into simple, usable documentation.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience in insurance, insurtech, or another regulated industry.
* Familiarity with independent insurance agencies, agency management systems, or managed service providers.
* Exposure to product management or experience feeding customer input into a product roadmap.
* Experience as an early hire who built an implementation or onboarding function.
* A property and casualty insurance license, or interest in obtaining one.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Every new agency partner follows a clear, documented path from signed agreement to active production.
* Sales and CPLs trust the handoff process, and agencies feel supported from day one.
* More signed agencies become active, producing partners, and they get there faster.
* UKON has an implementation playbook that can scale as we add partners and team members.
* Leadership has clear visibility into implementation progress and where agencies need help.

**Travel**
----------

This role requires travel of approximately 10 to 20 percent, including visits to agency partners and industry events.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

**Pay range:** 100,000 - 120,000 USD per year base salary, plus a variable bonus of up to 20,000 USD per year.

**Benefits:** Medical, dental, and vision coverage; 401(k); paid time off and paid holidays; and stock options.

jobs.description:
StudioBinder builds production management software used by agencies and creative teams to run their entire production workflow: crew and talent, scheduling, script breakdowns, shot lists, storyboards, media, and call sheets, backed by a blog reaching 1M+ monthly readers and a YouTube channel with 2M+ subscribers.

We're looking for a Technical Customer Success & Onboarding Specialist to own the full post-sale customer relationship, not just the first 30 days. This role owns onboarding end to end, verifies customers are actually adopting the platform, runs ongoing check-ins throughout the account lifecycle, manages renewals, and identifies expansion opportunities to hand back to sales. You'll also represent StudioBinder at industry trade shows alongside our sales team and be a visible face of the brand: on camera in support and product videos, and in person at events. This isn't a surface-level relationship role: you'll need to know the product inside and out, be genuinely comfortable diagnosing and clearly documenting bugs, and help test new releases before they ship.

Visit our Careers page (www.studiobinder.com/careers) to learn about our work culture, benefits, and a typical day.

Job Responsibilities:

* Own the customer relationship end to end: onboarding, adoption, renewals, and expansion, not just the initial ramp
* Develop true expert-level fluency with every StudioBinder feature, the person other reps and even the product team turn to when a workflow question comes up
* Investigate and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, file tickets, track them through to resolution, and rigorously test upcoming releases before they ship
* Onboard new customers and proactively guide them to value in their first weeks
* Run ongoing check-ins throughout the customer lifecycle to confirm real platform adoption, not just completed setup
* Own the renewals process for your accounts and flag at-risk accounts early
* Identify expansion opportunities during check-ins and hand qualified accounts to sales
* Join product demos alongside the sales team when needed, speaking to platform capabilities with confidence
* Represent StudioBinder at trade shows and industry events in and around Los Angeles, supporting our sales team on-site
* Write, film, and edit support and product videos, including on-screen appearances, plus write help documentation and tutorials
* Help train and refine our Intercom Fin AI assistant based on real customer conversations
* Respond to live chat and email support inquiries quickly and effectively
* Identify patterns in customer questions and relay insights to product, engineering, and content teams
* Balance reactive support (heaviest early in the week) against onboarding, renewals, documentation, and event work

Requirements:

* 3+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or technical support, ideally including renewals ownership
* Genuinely technical: comfortable digging into how the product actually works, reproducing and clearly documenting bugs, and building expert-level fluency with a complex SaaS tool, not just surface-level familiarity
* Hands-on QA, bug-testing, or technical support experience: reproducing issues, writing clear bug reports, and testing releases before they ship
* Background in sales, account management, or customer onboarding
* Experience with Intercom or a similar live chat/helpdesk platform strongly preferred
* Warm, engaging communicator who builds real rapport with customers and can confidently lead a conversation, a demo, a renewal discussion, or an on-camera segment
* Comfortable on camera and confident representing the brand at live events
* Basic video editing skills (Premiere, Final Cut, CapCut, or similar)
* Must type a minimum of 65 words per minute
* Detail-oriented, forward-thinking, and organized, able to manage a high ticket volume while owning longer-term account relationships
* Empathetic, patient, and conversational, with a genuinely positive attitude toward customers
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly to trade shows and industry events in and around Los Angeles

Bonus Points:

* Experience owning renewals or expansion/upsell targets in a SaaS environment
* Experience creating help documentation, tutorials, or support videos
* Familiarity with a bug/issue tracker (Jira, GitHub Issues, Linear, or similar)
* Advanced video editing or motion graphics experience
* Familiarity with a CRM (HubSpot, Salesforce, or similar)
* Live event or trade show experience
* Interest in filmmaking, storytelling, or creative tools

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
